guide.summary: OpenProject documents OAuth application registration on an instance, with an authorization code flow, token exchange, and bearer-token API requests. The api_v3 scope is the documented standard API scope, but the supplied sources do not name a narrower OAuth grant for reading work packages or show a read-only scope. Work package visibility depends on the connected user's permissions. Offset-based pagination is documented for collections. The exact OAuth permission for listing work packages remains unresolved.
guide.recommendation: The requested API test is not ready yet. Resolve the access mapping for Read titles of work packages the connected person can access, including paginated results. Use “Find missing request” or add official documentation beside that action.

findings.title: Register an OAuth application on the customer's OpenProject instance
findings.detail: Create the application in the instance OAuth applications settings, enter a name and redirect URL, select scopes, and save the client ID and client secret. The sources do not state who may create the application.
findings.appliesWhen: When connecting each customer instance through developer-owned OAuth

evidence.quote: Enter the Name of your OAuth application.

findings.title: Use the documented authorization code flow endpoints
findings.detail: The authorization endpoint takes response_type=code, client ID, redirect URI, space-separated scopes, and prompt=consent. The token endpoint exchanges the returned code using the client secret and redirect URI.
findings.appliesWhen: For user-delegated access where the connected person authorizes the app

Auth URL: https://example.com/oauth/authorize Access Token URL: https://example.com/oauth/token

https://example.com/oauth/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=<Client ID>&redirect_uri=<Redirect URI>&scope=<scope>&prompt=consent This requests redirects you to a URL that holds a code parameter which is the authentication code.

findings.title: Request the api_v3 scope for the standard API
findings.detail: api_v3 is the standard OpenProject API scope. If no scope is checked, api_v3 is assumed by default. The sources do not show that it limits access to read-only operations.
findings.appliesWhen: For OAuth requests to standard API resources such as work packages

findings.title: Work package visibility depends on the connected user's permissions
findings.detail: Work package collection responses document a MissingPermission error when the user is not allowed to see work packages. Returned titles are limited to what the connected person can access.
findings.appliesWhen: When the connected user lacks permission to view the requested work packages

steps.title: Read the first page of work package titles
steps.detail: Input provenance: INSTANCE_BASE_URL is the customer instance base URL and ACCESS_TOKEN is the OAuth token from the authorization step. Expected response: _embedded.elements entries with subject, which is the work package title, plus total, count and pageSize. Boundary check: confirm the granted scope and that only this GET request appears in the outgoing request log; do not send POST, PATCH or DELETE.
steps.doneWhen: The response is HTTP 200 with subject values for accessible work packages and the total, count and pageSize values are recorded.

evidence.quote: get /api/v3/work_packages Returns a collection of work packages.
Page number inside the requested collection.
subject The subject of the work package String not null; 1 <= length <= 255 READ / WRITE

fields: INSTANCE_BASE_URL: your full HTTPS instance URL, without a trailing slash
ACCESS_TOKEN from the test user authorization

steps.title: Page through all work package titles using offset pagination
steps.detail: Input provenance: same base URL and token. Start with offset=1 and advance by one page per request. Continue with the _links.nextByOffset link from each response while it is present. Stop when nextByOffset is absent or the accumulated count reaches total. Boundary check: confirm every request is GET and the request log shows no write methods; verify that no work package changed.
steps.doneWhen: Every page is read until nextByOffset is absent or accumulated count equals total, and the collected titles match total.
